en.title: How did the Oort cloud form at the birth of our solar system?
en.excerpt: Oort cloud comets are like dinosaur bones: remnants of the solar system's formation that hold the ingredients that built our planet.
en.body: Oort cloud comets are like dinosaur bones: they are remnants of the formation of the solar system. They contain the ingredients that built our planet.
